item.title: Iran War Live Updates: As Talks Drag On, Trump Says ‘I Don’t Care’ About Midterms Pressure
item.description: President Trump said U.S. politics would not affect his strategy in the unpopular war and was open to protracted peace talks. He also insisted that Iran would not control the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Lebanese Resigned to a Long War, Even if U.S. and Iran Make a Deal
item.description: Few in Lebanon believe that diplomatic efforts to end the wider war will bring peace to their country, as clashes between Israel and Hezbollah intensify in the south.

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump says no country will control Hormuz Strait under future Iran deal
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday told his cabinet that “nobody” would control the Strait of Hormuz under a future settlement with Iran, but maintained that the US would “watch over” the critical waterway. Tehran effectively closed the Strait to commercial shipping in response to the US-Israeli war on Iran, triggering a global oil shock. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: Five People Stuck in Flooded Laos Cave Are Found Alive
item.description: The five men, stranded while looking for gold, were found alive after a week in a narrow, muddy chamber. Two people remain missing.

item.title: More people are going hungry now than at the height of the pandemic
item.description: Food insecurity affects more families now than during the coronavirus pandemic, according to a new survey from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.

item.title: Palestine's Eid dampened by consequences of war on livestock
item.description: Palestinians in Gaza facing another grim Eid holiday, which starts Tuesday evening. The livestock sector there has been destroyed by the war, and Israel isn't allowing the import of live animals, making the traditional animal sacrifice nearly impossible. Restrictions on border crossings also mean Palestinians are unable to perform the pilgrimage to Mecca.

item.title: Residents Watch as Israeli War Planes Circle Over Southern Lebanon
item.description: Israel has intensified its deadly military campaign against Hezbollah, the Iran-backed militant group, in recent days, striking targets across Lebanon.

item.title: To Make a Deal With Trump, Iran Wants Billions of Its Money Unfrozen
item.description: The money has become a sticking point in talks, with Iran insisting that meaningful negotiations cannot begin without the funds’ release.

item.title: 5 things to know about the protests challenging Bolivia's new president
item.description: Less than six months ago, the inauguration of centrist President Rodrigo Paz seemed to usher in a new reality for Bolivians reeling from the worst economic crisis in a generation

item.title: Israel eliminates head of Hamas' military wing in Gaza strike
item.description: Israeli forces killed Mohammed Odeh, the new head of Hamas' military wing, in an airstrike in northern Gaza, according to the Israel Defense Forces.
